issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in CLI operations: read-modify-write without locking allows data

verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/cli.py tests/test_issue_5377_race_condition_locking.py

summary: Implemented file-based advisory locking using fcntl.flock to prevent race conditions in CLI operations. The lock protects the entire load-modify-save transaction, ensuring concurrent operations preserve all data.
approach: Added a lock context manager to TodoStorage that wraps the load-modify-save sequence. All CLI operations (add, mark_done, mark_undone, remove) now use this lock to prevent race conditions. The lock uses fcntl.flock which releases automatically on process termination, ensuring no stale locks.
risks: Lock file (.lock) may be left in the filesystem if process crashes (but lock is released automatically)
fcntl is Unix-specific; Windows support would require msvcrt or different approach
limitations: Only tested on Linux; cross-platform testing needed for Windows support
